LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在百貨公司專櫃 · At the department store boutique

text.traditional: 瑪莉，這家專櫃的洋裝看起來真漂亮，而且現在週年慶打八折呢！
text.simplified: 瑪莉，这家专柜的洋装看起来真漂亮，而且现在周年庆打八折呢！
text.english: Mary, this boutique's dress looks really beautiful, and there's a twenty percent discount for the anniversary sale!

text.traditional: 是挺好看的，但買衣服一定要先試穿，試穿看看合不合身再決定。
text.simplified: 是挺好看的，但买衣服一定要先试穿，试穿看看合不合身再决定。
text.english: It's quite nice, but when buying clothes one must always try them on first to see if they fit well before deciding.

text.traditional: 妳說得對。那我先進去試穿這件淺藍色的。
text.simplified: 你说得对。那我先进去试穿这件浅蓝色的。
text.english: You're right. Then I'll go inside first to try on this light blue one.

text.traditional: 瑪莉，妳看這件怎麼樣？我覺得腰部有點緊，而且價格還是太高了。
text.simplified: 瑪莉，你看这件怎么样？我觉得腰部有点紧，而且价格还是太高了。
text.english: Mary, what do you think of this piece? I feel the waist is a bit tight, and the price is still too high.

text.traditional: 與其買一件不舒服的名牌洋裝，不如到樓上的平價專櫃看看，那裡款式也很多。
text.simplified: 与其买一件不舒服的名牌洋装，不如到楼上的平价专柜看看，那里款式也很多。
text.english: Rather than buying an uncomfortable designer dress, it would be better to check the affordable section upstairs; there are many styles there too.

text.traditional: 可是樓上的衣服材質怎麼樣？我什麼衣服都穿過，就是皮膚容易過敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
text.simplified: 可是楼上的衣服材质怎么样？我什么衣服都穿过，就是皮肤容易过敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
text.english: But how is the material of the clothes upstairs? I've worn all kinds of clothes, it's just that my skin is easily allergic, so I can't wear rough fabrics.

text.traditional: 放心吧，樓上有幾個專櫃不僅質料柔軟，價格也很實在。
text.simplified: 放心吧，楼上有几个专柜不仅质料柔軟，价格也很实在。
text.english: Don't worry, several boutiques upstairs not only have soft materials, but their prices are very fair.

text.traditional: 太好了！那我們別再這裡浪費時間了，趕快上樓去逛逛吧。
text.simplified: 太好了！那我们别再这里浪费时间了，赶快上楼去逛逛吧。
text.english: Awesome! Then let's not waste more time here, let's head upstairs quickly to look around.

LESSON_THREE_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · Shopping Around to Get the Best Deal

text.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
text.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
text.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

text.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
text.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
text.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

text.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
text.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店鋪，费时又费力。
text.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

text.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
text.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查詢价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
text.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

text.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
text.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
text.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.

LESSON_THREE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express testing something through an action using 試+V.
grammarPages.explanation: 試 placed before a verb indicates attempting or testing something out before making a commitment.

items.question: Can 試+V take any multi-syllable verb phrase?
items.answer: 試+V typically pairs with monosyllabic action verbs of testing (試穿, 試開, 試吃, 試做).

right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shìchuān zhè jiàn yīfu.
right.english: I would like to try on these clothes.

items.question: Does 試+V replace 試試看?
items.answer: 試+V forms a compound testing action (試喝, 試開); 試試看 is placed after a verb phrase.

text.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺，覺得舒服再買。
text.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺，觉得舒服再买。
text.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhòu yídìng yào shìtǎng, juéde shūfu zài mǎi.
text.english: When buying a bed, you must definitely try lying on it, and only buy after feeling comfortable.

text.traditional: 那家超商提供新口味的飲料給客人免費試喝，喝過的人都說好喝。
text.simplified: 那家超商提供新口味的饮料给客人免费试喝，喝过的人都说好喝。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshāng tígōng xīn kǒuwèi de yǐnliào gěi kèrén miǎnfèi shìhē, hē guò de rén dōu shuō hǎohē.
text.english: That convenience store provides new flavor drinks for customers to taste test for free; everyone who tried praised it.

text.traditional: 這雙皮鞋很特別，你要不要先試穿看看？
text.simplified: 这双皮鞋很特别，你要不要先试穿看看？
text.pinyin: Zhè shuāng píxié hěn tèbié, nǐ yào bú yào xiān shìchuān kànkan?
text.english: This pair of leather shoes is very special; do you want to try wearing them first?

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Compare two choices and recommend the superior alternative using 不如.
grammarPages.explanation: 不如 indicates that option B is preferable or superior to option A (often paired with 與其…不如…).
grammarPages.pattern: Option A + 不如 + Option B

items.question: In recommendations, which option does 不如 favor?
items.answer: 不如 precedes the better choice: 'A 不如 B' means B is better than A.
items.wrongTraditional: 今天下雨，去爬山不如在家看書。
items.wrongSimplified: 今天下雨，去爬山不如在家看书。

right.traditional: 今天下雨，不如在家看書。
right.simplified: 今天下雨，不如在家看书。
right.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ, bùrú zài jiā kànshū.
right.english: It's raining today; it would be better to read at home.

items.question: Can 不如 be used without a preceding situation?
items.answer: 不如 usually introduces a sensible alternative given the current circumstance.

right.english: We might as well eat first.

text.traditional: 你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如賣掉吧！
text.simplified: 你那辆车不常开又旧得很，不如卖掉吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ nà liàng chē bù cháng kāi yòu jiù de hěn, bùrú mài diào ba!
text.english: You don't drive that car often and it's quite old; it would be better to sell it!

text.traditional: 外面雨下得這麼大，與其出去淋雨，不如在家看電影。
text.simplified: 外面雨下得这么大，与其出去淋雨，不如在家看电影。
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǔ xià de zhème dà, yǔqí chūqù línyǔ, bùrú zài jiā kàn diànyǐng.
text.english: It is raining so hard outside; rather than going out and getting soaked, it's better to watch a movie at home.

text.traditional: 與其每天怨天尤人，不如腳踏實地好好努力。
text.simplified: 与其每天怨天尤人，不如脚踏实地好好努力。
text.pinyin: Yǔqí měitiān yuàntiānyóurén, bùrú jiǎotàshídì hǎohǎo nǔlì.
text.english: Rather than complaining every day, it is better to work hard down to earth.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Introduce a sole reservation or exception using 就是.
grammarPages.explanation: When stating that everything is satisfactory or acceptable with one exception, 就是 introduces that sole reservation.

items.question: Does 就是 (except) indicate insistence?
items.answer: No. Here 就是 means 'the only drawback is... / it's just that', introducing a minor reservation.
items.wrongTraditional: 這件衣服很貴，就是很好。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件衣服很贵，就是很好。

right.traditional: 這件衣服很好，就是貴了一點。
right.simplified: 这件衣服很好，就是贵了一点。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎo, jiùshì guì le yìdiǎn.
right.english: These clothes are great; it's just that they're a bit expensive.

items.question: Where does reservation 就是 sit in the discourse?
items.answer: Reservation 就是 sits in the second clause, after the general positive evaluation.
items.wrongTraditional: 就是有點貴，這家店很好吃。
items.wrongSimplified: 就是有点贵，这家店很好吃。

right.traditional: 這家店很好吃，就是有點貴。
right.simplified: 这家店很好吃，就是有点贵。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn hěn hǎochī, jiùshì yǒudiǎn guì.
right.english: This restaurant is delicious; it's just a bit expensive.

text.traditional: 我剛大學畢業，什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受老闆要我每天加班到深夜。
text.simplified: 我刚大学毕业，什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受老闆要我每天加班到深夜。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dàxué bìyè, shénme gōngzuò wǒ dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bù néng jiēshòu lǎobǎn yào wǒ měitiān jiābān dào shēnyè.
text.english: I just graduated from university and am willing to do any job, it's just that I cannot accept the boss requiring me to work overtime until midnight every day.

text.traditional: 這間公寓格局很好、採光充足，就是離捷運站稍微遠了點。
text.simplified: 这间公寓格局很好、采光充足，就是离捷运站稍微远了点。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiān gōngyù géjú hěn hǎo, cǎiguāng chōngzú, jiùshì lí jiéyùnzhàn shāowēi yuǎn le diǎn.
text.english: This apartment has a great layout and ample sunlight, it's just slightly far from the MRT station.

text.traditional: 那位設計師什麼服裝都設計過，就是沒設計過帽子。
text.simplified: 那位设计师什么服装都设计过，就是没设计过帽子。
text.pinyin: Nà wèi shèjìshī shénme fúzhuāng dōu shèjì guò, jiùshì méi shèjì guò màozi.
text.english: That designer has designed all types of clothing, it's just that he has never designed hats.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 這家餐廳的菜色非常美味，服務也很親切，___價位稍高了些。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Persuade someone to cease an action using 別再…了.
grammarPages.explanation: 別再…了 expresses an urgent or earnest dissuasion, asking the listener to stop an ongoing or repeated action.

items.question: Can 別再…了 be used if the action hasn't started?
items.answer: No. 別再 implies the action was already happening and must now cease; use 別 for fresh warnings.

right.pinyin: Míngtiān kǎoshì, nǐ bié chídào le.
right.english: Tomorrow is the exam, don't be late.

items.question: Can 了 be dropped in 別再…了?
items.answer: 了 signals the change of state (stopping now) and is standard in this pattern.

text.traditional: 孩子對媽媽說：您別再幫我洗衣服了！我已經長大，自己會洗了。
text.simplified: 孩子对妈妈说：您别再帮我洗衣服了！我已经长大，自己会洗了。
text.pinyin: Háizi duì māma shuō: Nín bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ yǐjīng zhǎngdà, zìjǐ huì xǐ le.
text.english: The child said to mother: Don't wash clothes for me any longer! I have grown up and can wash them myself.

text.traditional: 醫生對病人說：您的胃已經發炎了，別再抽煙喝酒了。
text.simplified: 医生对病人说：您的胃已经发炎了，别再抽烟喝酒了。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng duì bìngrén shuō: Nín de wèi yǐjīng fāyán le, bié zài chōuyān hējiǔ le.
text.english: The doctor said to patient: Your stomach is inflamed; don't smoke and drink any longer.

text.traditional: 既然機會來了，就別再猶豫了，勇敢接受挑戰吧！
text.simplified: 既然机会来了，就别再猶豫了，勇敢接受挑战吧！
text.pinyin: Jìrán jīhuì lái le, jiù bié zài yóuyù le, yǒnggǎn jiēshòu tiǎozhàn ba!
text.english: Since the opportunity has arrived, don't hesitate any longer; bravely accept the challenge!

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

LESSON_THREE_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 5–6 · It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect two coordinated positive or negative attributes using 不僅…也/還….
grammarPages.explanation: 不僅…也/還… coordinates two clauses or predicates, introducing supplementary qualities with progressive emphasis.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不僅 + Predicate 1 + 也 / 還 + Predicate 2

items.question: Can 不僅 be paired with 但是?
items.answer: No. 不僅 is an additive conjunction; it pairs with 也 or 還, never with contrastive 但是.

right.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn cōngmíng yě hěn qínláo.
right.english: He is not only smart but also diligent.

items.question: How does 不僅 differ from 不但?
items.answer: 不僅 and 不但 share identical grammar; 不僅 has a more refined, formal tone.

right.traditional: 我不僅去過那裡也喜歡那裡。
right.simplified: 我不仅去过那里也喜欢那里。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bùjǐn qùguo nàlǐ yě xǐhuan nàlǐ.
right.english: I have not only been there, but also like it there.

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng bùjǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has an upbeat personality, but is also very conscientious at work, so coworkers all like him.

text.traditional: 這棟大樓不僅防震設計優良，通風與採光也十分理想。
text.simplified: 这栋大楼不仅防震设计优良，通风与采光也十分理想。
text.pinyin: Zhè dòng dàlóu bùjǐn fángzhèn shèjì yōuliáng, tōngfēng yǔ cǎiguāng yě shífēn lǐxiǎng.
text.english: This building not only has excellent earthquake-resistant design, but ventilation and lighting are also very ideal.

text.traditional: 現代消費者不僅看重商品價格，還特別講究環保與健康。
text.simplified: 现代消费者不仅看重商品价格，还特别讲究环保与健康。
text.pinyin: Xiàndài xiāofèizhě bùjǐn kànzhòng shāngpǐn jiàgé, hái tèbié jiǎngjiū huánbǎo yǔ jiànkāng.
text.english: Modern consumers not only care about product price, but also emphasize environmental friendliness and health.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Doesn't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express progressive increase with each iteration using 一+Classifier+比+一+Classifier.
grammarPages.explanation: Repeating the classifier in the pattern '一 M 比 一 M + Adjective' denotes progressive increase over successive occurrences.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一 M 比 一 M + Adjective / Predicate

items.question: Can 一次比一次 be followed by an unchanged state?
items.answer: No. It requires a scalar adjective showing progressive increase (好, 難, 貴).
items.wrongTraditional: 他的成績一次比一次一樣。
items.wrongSimplified: 他的成绩一次比一次一样。

right.traditional: 他的成績一次比一次好。
right.simplified: 他的成绩一次比一次好。
right.pinyin: Tā de chéngjī yí cì bǐ yí cì hǎo.
right.english: His grades are better each time.

items.question: Can other measure words replace 次 in this pattern?
items.answer: Yes! You can say 一年比一年 (year by year) or 一天比一天 (day by day).

right.pinyin: Tiānqì yì tiān bǐ yì tiān lěng.
right.english: The weather gets colder day by day.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhège xuéqī Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjī yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming studied very hard this semester, and his test scores improved with each exam.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxi, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because there are more and more factories in this region, the air quality has worsened year by year.

text.traditional: 他的廚藝在不斷練習之下，做出來的菜餚一次比一次可口。
text.simplified: 他的厨艺在不断练习之下，做出来的菜餚一次比一次可口。
text.pinyin: Tā de chúyì zài búduàn liànxí zhī xià, zuò chūlái de càiyáo yí cì bǐ yí cì kěkǒu.
text.english: Under continuous practice of culinary skills, the dishes he prepares become more delicious every time.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · Shopping Around to Get the Best Deal

text.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
text.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
text.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

text.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
text.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
text.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

text.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
text.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店鋪，费时又费力。
text.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

text.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
text.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查詢价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
text.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

text.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
text.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
text.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.
